headline: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
summary: California Gov. Newsom signed seven bills targeting AI data centers. Laws aim to prevent utility costs from burdening residents. Data centers now face new rates and must pay for infrastructure upgrades.

headline: GM can’t ‘bring back’ Apple CarPlay because it never left
summary: GM announced new software for trucks, including Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. This caused confusion, as GM previously removed these from EVs. CarPlay wasn't entirely gone but is being re-integrated into new models.

headline: Paramount settles lawsuit blocking $110 billion Warner Bros. merger
summary: Paramount settled a lawsuit with California and 11 other states. This removes a major obstacle for the $110 billion Warner Bros. Discovery merger. The proposed consent decree includes specific requirements for the deal.

headline: Bungie says it’s ‘not done with Destiny’ and will bring back vaulted content
summary: Bungie plans to restore previously 'vaulted' content to Destiny 2. This reverses a controversial six-year-old content removal policy. Players will regain access to old campaigns, destinations, and raids.

headline: Get a Cordless Electric Air Duster for Your PC Maintenance for Just $17 Ahead of Prime Day
summary: Score a cordless electric air duster for only $17. It's perfect for PC maintenance and cleaning electronics. Ditch expensive, single-use compressed air canisters.

headline: Indie Game Developer Accuses Studio of Using AI to Rip Off His Viral Potato Peeling Game
summary: An indie developer claims another studio used AI to copy his viral potato-peeling game. The accusation highlights growing concerns about AI-powered plagiarism in gaming. His original game is a first-person, physics-based title.

headline: Daredevil: Born Again Will Reportedly End With Season 3, Showrunner Departs Amidst Post-Production
summary: Daredevil: Born Again is reportedly set to conclude after its third season. The showrunner has departed the project during post-production. This news raises questions about the series' future.

headline: Blizzard Says StarCraft 'Won't Be Exclusive' When It Launches in 2030
summary: Blizzard confirms its open-world StarCraft shooter will launch in 2030. The game will not be exclusive to Xbox platforms. This means a broader release for the anticipated title.

headline: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
summary: A second air traffic control glitch caused further widespread disruption. Airlines are criticizing the UK's air traffic control system. Prime Minister Andy Burnham expressed serious concern over the recurring issues.

headline: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with 'defensive' military support, says Burnham
summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham announced 'defensive' military aid for Saudi Arabia. Support includes air-to-air refuelling requested by the kingdom. This aid follows recent attacks on Saudi Arabia from Houthis in Yemen.

headline: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
summary: Yemenis are fleeing the escalating conflict by crossing the Red Sea. They are seeking refuge in Djibouti from intensified fighting. The conflict involves Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed forces.

headline: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
summary: The first UK charges related to the 1994 Rwanda genocide have been brought. Dr. Vincent Brown, 65, faces seven offences. He is scheduled to appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court.
